item.title: 監視対象ページに変更がありました（5件）
item.description:
監視対象ページに変更がありました。

変更ページ数: 5件

iOS_App Store Connect リリースノート

対象URL: https://developer.apple.com/app-store-connect/release-notes/

検出した最終更新日: 検出できませんでした

差分詳細: https://Sarasaraaa.github.io/web-watch-system/diffs/017c7c51ef4ae955.html


変更サマリ:
+September 23, 2026
+App Store Connect update
+App Store Connect 3.3 is now available on the App Store for iPhone and iPad. This update includes:
+Landscape orientation on iPhone.
+Resizing when using iPhone Mirroring on Mac, on devices running OS version 27 or later (available in supported countries and regions).
+We’ve also significantly sped up the process of inviting internal testers on teams with many users, along with other stability improvements and bug fixes.
